mappings.key_fact: Enterprise account (Meridian Retail Group) explicitly paused replenishment orders and migrated volume to competitor due to three of five deliveries missing SLA in June; account loss is direct revenue impact.
Consumer order promised in 2 days delivered on day 6 due to warehouse dispatch delay at WH-07; second late delivery that month triggered refund request, demonstrating SLA breach mechanism.
SMB repeat customer complaint about 4-day late delivery explicitly cited competitor's 2-day express as alternative; flagged churn risk directly linked to SLA failure.
WH-07 backlog of 1,900 orders with oldest at 5 days and manual sortation at 60% capacity; CS reports climbing complaint volume driven by late deliveries, establishing operational root cause.
Enterprise account (Kalinga Mart) renewal at risk after QBR due to four PO delivery misses in June; procurement evaluating competitor express program, indicating imminent account loss.
Historical case from East region in 2025-11 describes SLA recovery but does not provide evidence about current North-West region or July 2026 drivers.
